title: Design System: EZ Garage Doors — PROJECTED LIGHT (hand-processed 16mm)
northStar: The company's work record projected as hand-processed film: near-black leader, silver stamped caps, real frames on a sprocketed strip, and orange only ever as light — leaks, flares, the beam. Every CTA is a light-flooded frame plate.

world.predecessor: Orange Editorial Utility (retired 2026-08-19; rollback tag v2026.07-orange-editorial)

strip.grain: SVG feTurbulence overlay at 0.42, frames ONLY — the page never carries texture
strip.frameCharacter: inset rebate edge (1px + falloff) and a leak catch on each frame's right edge

devices: leak gradient (--leak-gradient): hero right edge, section rules, footer top edge
flare plates: grain-textured flood gradient CTAs with square sprocket tabs
projector beam: .section--orange radial beam on leader ground
light-struck type: hero lit line exposure rising toward the leak (background-clip)
perforation ticks: small flare squares in edge-print assemblies
light.banned: flat orange text on cards/labels; orange-filled section grounds

budget: hero leak single breath (2.8s ease-out, once)
motion.reducedMotion: all animation killed globally; leak renders settled

contrastRules: flare (#f36a21) on leader: 6.1:1 — passes all sizes when used as text-like edge print
leader (#141210) on flare plates: 6.1:1 — CTA text at any size

browserSurfaces.scrollbar: thin, flare thumb on panel track

voice.annotationGrammar: mono uppercase tracked (edge codes, frame numerals, metadata); stamps in condensed caps
voice.claimsGate: every factual claim must exist in website/src/config/business.ts APPROVED_CLAIMS/STATS

proofRules: proof-framed strips carry real, person-free photographs only
AI/model imagery is illustrative-only and never sits inside record framing
review proof = platform ratings/counts + outbound links; no on-site quotes until verbatim reviews exist
